name: ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ2
statusNote: ecom lists it as discontinued. Security patches ended in Q3 2025; hardware service runs to Q4 2027.
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 8-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 13. It has been discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ2 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T5 Gc IP64 / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T85°C Dc

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T5 Gc IP64 / Ex ic IIIC T85°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: SGS: Class I, Division 2, Groups A,B,C,D T5; Class II, Division 2, Groups F,G T100°C; Class III, Division 1; Class I, Zone 2, Group IIC, T5; Zone 22, Group IIIB T100°C; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: SIM/SD tray and Ex-protective case correctly fitted; wired USB and SIM/SD changes only in ordinary locations; charge only −5 °C to +45 °C; device not to be repaired or dismantled (IECEx EPS 21.0033X).

specs.chip: Samsung Exynos 9810 octa-core (4 x 2.7 GHz + 4 x 1.7 GHz)
specs.touch: Can be operated while wearing gloves

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 610 g in use
limitations: Discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ2 replaces it
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T5 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 100 °C
